items.headline: Louisiana hosts South Alabama in Sun Belt action

items.headline: Robinson, Wilder help Southern Miss run past Louisiana-Lafayette 35-31
items.description: — Steven Robinson ran for three touchdowns and Jamarice Wilder raced 16 yards for the winning touchdown with 58 seconds to play and Southern Miss pulled out a 35-31 win over Louisiana-Lafayette on Saturday night.

items.headline: Louisiana Tech beats Louisiana-Lafayette 32-31 after 19-point 4th quarter
items.description: — Blake Baker threw three touchdown passes and ran for another score, and Louisiana Tech scored 19 points in the fourth quarter to beat Louisiana-Lafayette 32-31 on Saturday night.
